text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, dabigatran etexilate mesylate is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Current inventory across three sites provides 13.3 to 32 days of supply depending on strength and location. Corvale East has the lowest coverage at 13.3 days for the 110 mg presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include dabigatran etexilate mesylate as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but thin at Corvale East for the 110 mg strength. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Alternate manufacturers are available but none have identifiable plant locations on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place a replenishment order for 110 mg capsules to Corvale East from the primary wholesaler; requires pharmacy director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. (ranked option 1) for 110 mg supply if primary wholesaler cannot deliver within 7 days; requires pharmacy director and P&T committee chair approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage at all three sites and report days-on-hand weekly; requires pharmacy operations manager approval.
4. Buyer to confirm allocation limits with the primary wholesaler for both strengths; requires pharmacy director approval.

Not recommended: Switching patients to alternative anticoagulants or changing prescribing patterns based on current inventory levels.
